description: NaLi₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are two shorter (2.63 Å) and four longer (2.70 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Li-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.63 Å. There are five inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded to one Na and five equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNaLi₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. The Cl-Na bond length is 2.70 Å. There are a spread of Cl-Li bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.63 Å.
